The **`watershed`** R package was extracted from `ewing` into a standalone repository located at [`~/Documents/GitHub/watershed`](../) and published to GitHub at [byandell/watershed](https://github.com/byandell/watershed).

## 1. Package Architecture & Components

- **R Source Code (`R/`)**:
  - [`R/watershedApp.R`](../R/watershedApp.R) & [`R/leafletApp.R`](../R/leafletApp.R) — Interactive Shiny application modules and wrappers.
  - [`R/watershed.R`](../R/watershed.R) & [`R/leaflet.R`](../R/leaflet.R) — USGS HUC subwatershed retrieval, spatial clipping, and Leaflet overlays.
  - [`R/habitat.R`](../R/habitat.R) — OpenStreetMap habitat feature extraction, landmark geocoding, and substrate suitability scoring.
  - [`R/step_controls.R`](../R/step_controls.R) — Geometric scale slider builders (`10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000`) and slider choice parsers.
  - [`R/get_site_cache_file.R`](../R/get_site_cache_file.R) — Multi-landscape spatial cache resolver for `"watershed"`.

- **Package Infrastructure & CI/CD**:
  - [`DESCRIPTION`](../DESCRIPTION), [`NAMESPACE`](../NAMESPACE), [`README.md`](../README.md), and [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
  - [`_pkgdown.yml`](../_pkgdown.yml) & [`.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml`](../.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml) — Automated pkgdown site generation and `gh-pages` deployment.

- **Data Caches & Quarto Demos**:
  - Pre-cached spatial layers in [`inst/extdata/`](../inst/extdata/).
  - Standalone launchers [`app.R`](../app.R) & [`inst/watershedApp/app.R`](../inst/watershedApp/app.R).
  - Quarto gallery and tutorial vignette in [`demos/`](../demos/) (`demos/index.qmd`, `demos/watershedApp.qmd`).

## 2. Refinements & Quality Assurance

- **R CMD Check Validation**: Corrected S3 method exports (`@exportS3Method ggplot2::autoplot`), suppressed spherical geometry (`s2`) messages and planar warnings, declared global variables, and verified **`0 errors | 0 warnings | 0 notes (Status: OK)`**.
- **Quarto Gallery & Hotlink Fix**: Formatted card containers in [`demos/index.qmd`](../demos/index.qmd) using 4-colon outer fences (`:::: {.grid}`) and added Bootstrap `.stretched-link` styling so clicking anywhere on a demo card navigates to its page.
- **GitHub Integration**: Initialized remote repository `byandell/watershed`, configured issue tracker links, and published documentation to [https://byandell.github.io/watershed/](https://byandell.github.io/watershed/).

## 3. Granularity Controls & Grid Scaling

- **Transparent Polygon & Watershed Styling**:
  - Configured Leaflet and `ggplot2` autoplots ([`R/leaflet.R`](../R/leaflet.R), [`R/leafletApp.R`](../R/leafletApp.R), [`R/watershed.R`](../R/watershed.R), [`R/habitat.R`](../R/habitat.R)) to use transparent fills (`fillOpacity = 0` / `fill = NA`) for drawn regions, subwatershed boundaries, and hexagonal substrate meshes while maintaining distinct border outlines and click interactivity.

- **Zero-Overhead Code-Annealed HUC Scaling**:
  - Enhanced `get_hucs_from_polygon(polygon_sf, max_hucs = 6)` to auto-scale HUC subwatershed granularity dynamically based on the extent of a user-drawn bounding polygon.
  - Inspects 12-digit HUC string prefixes in memory (`HUC12` $\rightarrow$ `HUC10` $\rightarrow$ `HUC08` $\rightarrow$ `HUC06` $\rightarrow$ `HUC04`) after a single HUC12 spatial AOI query, selecting the finest level with $\le \text{max\_hucs}$ regions.

- **Geometric Hexagon Scale & Gray Background Layering**:
  - Replaced degree diameter sliders with an indexed geometric scale slider (`n_hexagons`, values: `10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000`, default: `100`) via [`R/step_controls.R`](../R/step_controls.R).
  - Dynamically computes cell diameter $d = \sqrt{A / (0.65 \times N)}$ based on region bounding box area $A$, guaranteeing consistent grid cell density across both small islands and multi-state regional watersheds.
  - Rendered hex grid in subtle slate gray (`#7F8C8D`) and positioned it **behind** HUC boundaries in Leaflet maps and `ggplot2` autoplots.

- **Consolidated Single-Object Download**:
  - Consolidated sidebar download options in [`R/watershedApp.R`](../R/watershedApp.R) into a single **Download Watershed Topology (.rds)** button (`download_watershed`).
  - Downloads a single unified S3 spatial topology object containing all layers (`layer` boundary `sf`, `individual_hucs` `sf`, `hex_overlay` `sfc`, `hex_habitat_sf` suitability `sf`, `habitat_sf` features `sf`, and `landmarks_sf` POI points).

## 4. Interactive Drawing & Geometry Safety Refinements

- **Native Leaflet Draw Toolbar & Single-Feature Auto-Replacement**:
  - Configured `leaflet.extras::addDrawToolbar()` with `singleFeature = TRUE` and styled stroke colors (`#000000`, `weight = 1.5`).
  - Drawing a new region (Polygon, Rectangle, or Pin Marker) automatically replaces and purges previous drawn shapes on the Leaflet map canvas, preventing lingering outlines.
  - Streamlined toolbar choices to 3 robust native options: **Polygon**, **Rectangle**, and **Pin Marker**.

- **Defensive Polygon Geometry Guards**:
  - Added strict geometry type checks in `get_watershed()` ([`R/watershed.R`](../R/watershed.R)) and `render_huc_shapes()` ([`R/leafletApp.R`](../R/leafletApp.R)).
  - When `huc_layer` or `feature_sf` is a point (e.g. from point selection), `get_watershed()` automatically discards non-polygon geometries and fetches the true `MULTIPOLYGON` USGS watershed boundary from NHDPlus, preventing Leaflet `to_ring.default` rendering errors.

- **Point Selection & Compact Marker Styling**:
  - Configured single-click point selection via the Pin Marker draw tool (`markerOptions`).
  - Styled point selections on the Leaflet map with a compact `3.5px` solid black circle marker (`color = "#000000"`, `fillOpacity = 0.9`).

## 5. HUC Level Selection & In-Memory Spatial Aggregation

- **Sidebar HUC Level Control (`2–12`)**:
  - Configured sidebar slider in [`R/watershedApp.R`](../R/watershedApp.R) (`input$huc_level`, `min = 2, max = 12, value = 8, step = 2`) to select target HUC digit levels (`HUC02` through `HUC12`).
  - Formatted HUC layer names and code identifiers with standard two-digit zero padding (`"huc02"`, `"huc04"`, `"huc06"`, `"huc08"`, `"huc10"`, `"huc12"`).

- **0-API-Call In-Memory Spatial Union Aggregation**:
  - Added `aggregate_hucs(hucs_sf, target_level)` in [`R/leaflet.R`](../R/leaflet.R) for zero-overhead in-memory spatial union (`sf::st_union`) of cached base geometries (`raw_fetched_hucs`).
  - Moving the slider from finer to broader levels (e.g. `12` $\rightarrow$ `10` $\rightarrow$ `8` $\rightarrow$ `6` $\rightarrow$ `4` $\rightarrow$ `2`) re-aggregates shapes in real-time with **0 network API calls**.

- **Area-Based Query Scaling & UI Synchronization**:
  - Scaled initial queries based on drawn polygon extent ($km^2$) to avoid REST API timeouts over multi-state regions.
  - Automatically synced the sidebar slider (`shiny::updateSliderInput`) to match the safest base level determined for the region upon searching.
  - Reset sidebar selectize dropdown choices and selected values (`input$huc12_id`) in sync when clicking **Clear Region** or purging drawn shapes.
